slots.th: table-cell [position:var(--arena-sticky-position,static)] top-0 z-1 border-[color:var(--data-header-edge-rest,var(--edge-separator))] bg-[color:var(--data-header-fill-rest,var(--fill-track))] text-[color:color-mix(in_oklab,var(--data-header-ink-rest,var(--ink-muted))_var(--level-ink-muted),transparent)] w-[var(--arena-column-width,auto)] px-row-px py-row-py [text-align:var(--arena-column-align,left)] align-middle font-face-label text-label font-bold tracking-label-role case-label border-b-[length:var(--bw-separator)] outline-none focus:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_var(--bw-focus)_var(--edge-focus)]
slots.td: table-cell w-[var(--arena-column-width,auto)] px-row-px py-row-py [text-align:var(--arena-column-align,left)] align-middle text-ctl outline-none focus:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_var(--bw-focus)_var(--edge-focus)]
slots.link: inline-flex items-center min-h-ctl-h-sm cursor-pointer no-underline text-[color:color-mix(in_oklab,var(--navigation-plain-link-ink-rest,var(--ink-link))_var(--level-ink-body),transparent)] rounded-control outline-none transition-[color] duration-[var(--dur-hover)] ease-hover hover:text-[color:var(--navigation-plain-link-ink-hover,var(--ink-heading))] focus:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_var(--bw-focus)_var(--edge-focus)]
slots.empty: px-4 py-8 text-center align-middle text-ctl text-ink-muted/(--level-ink-muted)
slots.card: flex flex-col gap-stack border-[color:var(--surfaces-plain-card-edge-rest,var(--edge-surface))] bg-[color:var(--surfaces-plain-card-fill-rest,var(--fill-surface))] border-[length:var(--bw-surface)] rounded-surface p-row-px shadow-surface-rest
slots.cardLabel: font-face-label text-label font-bold tracking-label-role case-label text-ink-muted/(--level-ink-muted)
slots.cardBlock: w-full flex justify-end gap-2 border-t-[length:var(--bw-separator)] border-[color:var(--surfaces-separator-edge-rest,var(--edge-separator))] pt-2

internal.narrow: the table is narrower than the md breakpoint and responsive
internal.first: the first row of the body (rowIndex <= 1), which draws no rule above itself
